info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Cancellation API enables users to effectively cancel existing logistics shipment requests. This functionality is essential for logistics managers and operational teams who need to adjust shipments in response to changing circumstances. By using this API, businesses can ensure that logistics operations remain fluid and adaptable, reducing potential losses due to unneeded shipments. Typical consumers include third-party logistics providers and internal teams managing shipment workflows.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel a shipment that has been previously scheduled. Make sure to verify the shipment details before proceeding with cancellation, as this action is irreversible.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a shipment. It should contain the necessary information to identify the shipment that needs to be canceled.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for canceling shipments.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancel Shipment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier of the result for this operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment after the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation request.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation to cancel a shipment.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Detailed audit information regarding the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
